title: Direct integration (simplest type)

steps.instruction: Integrate both sides with respect to $x$.
Apply the initial condition to find $C$.

answer: The particular solution is $y = x^4 - 2x + 4$. (The general solution $y = x^4 - 2x + C$ is a family of curves; the initial condition picks out the one passing through $(1, 3)$.)

title: Mixture / flow problem
problem: A tank contains 50 L of pure water. Brine containing 3 g/L flows in at 2 L/min; the well-mixed solution drains at 2 L/min. Set up and solve the differential equation for the salt content $Q(t)$ (grams) at time $t$ minutes.

steps.instruction: Set up the rate in / rate out equation.
Apply the initial condition $Q(0) = 0$ to find $A$, then write $Q$ in terms of $t$.

answer: $Q(t) = 150\left(1 - e^{-t/25}\right)$ grams. As $t \to \infty$, $Q \to 150$ g — the brine concentration (3 g/L × 50 L) is the long-run equilibrium, as expected.
